summary: This component creates a 'TL;DR' (Too Long; Didn't Read) summary box for blog posts. It extracts the text content from React elements and embeds it as JSON-LD structured data so search engines understand it's an abstract, then displays the content in a styled alert box with a lightning bolt icon.

explanations.7: This function recursively walks through React's tree structure to pull out plain text strings, handling strings, numbers, arrays, and React components with children properties.
explanations.12: We're using type assertion to tell TypeScript 'treat this unknown object as if it has a props object with children' so we can safely access the nested children property.
explanations.24: useMemo caches the structured data object so it only gets recreated when the children prop actually changes, avoiding unnecessary recalculations on every render.
explanations.36: JSON-LD (JSON for Linking Data) is a format that search engines like Google use to understand what type of content is on a page; we're telling them this is a blog post with an abstract.
explanations.40: We're combining multiple CSS classes—both Bootstrap alert styles and custom styles from the imported stylesheet—to style the box.
explanations.41: The role and aria-label make this section accessible to screen readers by identifying it as a distinct region labeled 'Article Summary'.
